assets.title: The vista: eroded heights, baked light, lake mask, forest and sky panorama
assets.author: This repository (original work)
assets.license: Original work, released with the repository

sources.note: the designed plateau, valley and lake the bake grows from

processingSteps: streampower.mjs: tectonic uplift against stream-power incision (Cordonnier et al. 2016; Braun and Willett 2013; Priority-Flood + epsilon), 16.4 km at 8 m and 4 km at 2 m, 58 min on the CPU
erode_gpu.py: 40 M + 20 M droplets of hydraulic erosion (after Beyer 2015) and a talus pass, CUDA via NVIDIA Warp
render_sky.py: 8192 x 2321 path-traced cumulus sky, 768 spp, delta tracking, approximate Mie phase (Jendersie and d'Eon 2023), in the game's own atmosphere; 64 min on an RTX 2060
light_gpu.py: materials from the erosion record; sun (disc-sampled, terrain, canopy and cloud shadows), 4096-ray sky gather against the panorama, one bounce
export.py: delta-coded uint16 heights (gzip), sRGB WebP light maps, flood-filled lake mask, lit tree instances, variance-guided denoised sky, horizon haze by azimuth

policy: Only CC0, public-domain, NASA or CC-BY assets ship. Every shipped file is listed with its source, licence, sha256 and processing.
